Suitable Indian States: West Bengal, Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, Bihar, Odisha, Assam, Kerala, Telangana, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Haryana
Suitable Soil Types: Clay soil, Alluvial soil, Loamy soil, Red soil
Cultivation Guide: Direct seeding or transplanting 20-25 days old seedlings in puddled soil. Maintain 2-5 cm standing water during vegetative stages. Drain water 10 days before harvest.
Pest & Disease Advisory: Yellow stem borer, brown planthopper (BPH), blast disease. Use pheromone traps and resistant cultivars.

Suitable Indian States: Punjab, Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Bihar, Gujarat, Maharashtra, Himachal Pradesh
Suitable Soil Types: Alluvial soil, Loamy soil, Clay soil, Black soil
Cultivation Guide: Requires well-pulverized seedbed. Sow in lines (20-22 cm apart) with seed-cum-fertilizer drill. First irrigation (CRI stage) at 21 days after sowing is critical.
Pest & Disease Advisory: Yellow rust, brown rust, loose smut. Treat seed with Carboxin/Thiram; spray Tebuconazole if rust appears.

Suitable Indian States: Maharashtra, Gujarat, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Punjab, Haryana, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Tamil Nadu
Suitable Soil Types: Black soil, Alluvial soil, Red soil, Loamy soil
Cultivation Guide: Thrives on deep black cotton soil (regur) with good internal drainage. Dibble seeds at 90x60 cm. Monitor for bollworm and sucking pests using yellow sticky traps.
Pest & Disease Advisory: Pink bollworm, whitefly, aphids. Implement IPM, avoid synthetic pyrethroids early, use neem seed kernel extract.

Suitable Indian States: Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Gujarat, Bihar, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Punjab, Haryana
Suitable Soil Types: Alluvial soil, Black soil, Loamy soil, Clay soil
Cultivation Guide: Plant three-budded setts in furrows 90 cm apart. Requires frequent irrigations and trash mulching to conserve moisture. Earthing up prevents lodging.
Pest & Disease Advisory: Early shoot borer, top borer, red rot. Use trichogramma cards and plant disease-resistant varieties (Co 0238, Co 86032).

Suitable Indian States: Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Rajasthan, Karnataka, Telangana, Gujarat, Andhra Pradesh
Suitable Soil Types: Black soil, Loamy soil, Clay soil
Cultivation Guide: Inoculate seeds with Bradyrhizobium japonicum culture before sowing. Requires well-drained fertile loam; extremely sensitive to waterlogging.
Pest & Disease Advisory: Girdle beetle, semilooper, yellow mosaic virus. Timely weed control and seed treatment with Imidacloprid.

Suitable Indian States: Gujarat, Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Rajasthan, Maharashtra, Odisha, Telangana
Suitable Soil Types: Sandy soil, Red soil, Loamy soil
Cultivation Guide: Requires light sandy loam with friable texture for easy peg penetration. Apply gypsum at 200-400 kg/ha at pegging stage to enhance pod filling.
Pest & Disease Advisory: Tikka leaf spot, collar rot, white grub. Seed treatment with Trichoderma and timely Chlorpyrifos soil drenching.

Suitable Indian States: Rajasthan, Haryana, Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal, Punjab, Gujarat, Bihar, Assam
Suitable Soil Types: Loamy soil, Alluvial soil, Sandy soil
Cultivation Guide: Conserves winter moisture well. Apply balanced NPK with elemental sulfur (20-30 kg/ha) to boost seed oil content. Guard against aphid attacks during cloudy weather.
Pest & Disease Advisory: Mustard aphid, white rust, Alternaria blight. Spray Dimethoate or neem oil when aphid colony reaches ETL.

Suitable Indian States: Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Rajasthan, Karnataka, Uttar Pradesh, Gujarat, Andhra Pradesh, Haryana
Suitable Soil Types: Black soil, Loamy soil, Alluvial soil
Cultivation Guide: Deep taproot system suitable for drylands. Avoid excessive moisture which causes wilt and root rot. Treat seeds with Trichoderma and Rhizobium.
Pest & Disease Advisory: Gram pod borer (Helicoverpa armigera), Fusarium wilt. Install pheromone traps and spray HaNPV or bio-pesticides.

Suitable Indian States: Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Karnataka, Uttar Pradesh, Gujarat, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Odisha, Bihar
Suitable Soil Types: Black soil, Red soil, Loamy soil, Alluvial soil
Cultivation Guide: Deep rooted drought-tolerant pulse. Excellent for intercropping with soybean, cotton, or millets. Nipping apical bud at 45 days induces profuse branching.
Pest & Disease Advisory: Pod fly, pod borer, sterility mosaic. Intercrop with sorghum or maize and apply targeted sprays at 50% flowering.

Suitable Indian States: Maharashtra, Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh, Andhra Pradesh, Rajasthan, Telangana, Tamil Nadu, Gujarat
Suitable Soil Types: Black soil, Red soil, Loamy soil, Clay soil
Cultivation Guide: Highly drought-resistant C4 plant. Tolerates moderate salinity. Ideal for arid and semi-arid tracts of Deccan plateau.
Pest & Disease Advisory: Shoot fly, stem borer. Early sowing with higher seed rate and seed treatment with Chlorpyrifos.

Suitable Indian States: Rajasthan, Gujarat, Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu
Suitable Soil Types: Sandy soil, Loamy soil, Red soil
Cultivation Guide: Remarkable tolerance to heat and drought. Can be grown in marginal sandy soils of Rajasthan and Gujarat with very low water input.
Pest & Disease Advisory: Downy mildew (green ear), ergot. Use certified hybrid seeds with metalaxyl treatment.

Suitable Indian States: Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Odisha, Andhra Pradesh, Maharashtra, Himachal Pradesh, Kerala
Suitable Soil Types: Red soil, Laterite soil, Loamy soil
Cultivation Guide: Rich in calcium and dietary fiber. Hardy crop resisting dry spells, grown across red soils of Southern Karnataka and Odisha hills.
Pest & Disease Advisory: Blast (leaf, neck, and finger blast). Spray Tricyclazole or Mancozeb on first appearance of spindle lesions.

Suitable Indian States: Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, Andhra Pradesh, Odisha, Karnataka, Bihar, Gujarat, Tamil Nadu
Suitable Soil Types: Loamy soil, Alluvial soil, Red soil, Black soil
Cultivation Guide: Short duration catch crop fitting neatly between Kharif and Rabi rotations. Fixes atmospheric nitrogen, improving organic soil fertility.
Pest & Disease Advisory: Yellow mosaic virus transmitted by whitefly, pod borer. Control whiteflies with yellow sticky traps and systemic sprays.

Suitable Indian States: Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh, Bihar, Maharashtra, Telangana, Punjab, Andhra Pradesh, Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh
Suitable Soil Types: Alluvial soil, Red soil, Loamy soil, Black soil
Cultivation Guide: Ensure proper soil preparation, balanced nutrition, and timely irrigation.
Pest & Disease Advisory: Adopt Integrated Pest Management (IPM) practices.

Suitable Indian States: Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal, Bihar, Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, Punjab, Haryana, Assam, Himachal Pradesh
Suitable Soil Types: Sandy soil, Loamy soil, Alluvial soil
Cultivation Guide: Needs well-aerated loose sandy loam. Plant disease-free certified seed tubers with sprouts upward. Regular earthing up protects tubers from direct sunlight.
Pest & Disease Advisory: Late blight, early blight, bacterial wilt. Spray Mancozeb / Cymoxanil before rainy spells to prevent late blight.

Suitable Indian States: Maharashtra, Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat, Bihar, Rajasthan, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Tamil Nadu
Suitable Soil Types: Loamy soil, Black soil, Alluvial soil, Red soil
Cultivation Guide: Transplant 6-8 week old nursery seedlings. Sensitive to weed competition in early stages. Stop irrigation 15 days prior to harvest to prevent rotting.
Pest & Disease Advisory: Thrips, purple blotch, basal rot. Spray Fipronil or Profenofos and ensure adequate crop rotation.

Suitable Indian States: Andhra Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Karnataka, Odisha, Gujarat, Maharashtra, West Bengal, Bihar, Tamil Nadu, Himachal Pradesh
Suitable Soil Types: Loamy soil, Red soil, Black soil, Alluvial soil
Cultivation Guide: Stake plants for indeterminate varieties. Provide drip fertigation for high fruit quality. Prune suckers to channel energy into fruit sizing.
Pest & Disease Advisory: Tomato leaf curl virus (whitefly vector), fruit borer, early blight. Use nylon net nurseries and fruit borer pheromone lures.

Suitable Indian States: Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, Gujarat, Andhra Pradesh, Kerala, Karnataka, Bihar, Assam, West Bengal, Odisha
Suitable Soil Types: Loamy soil, Clay soil, Alluvial soil, Red soil
Cultivation Guide: Propagated using tissue culture plants or disease-free sword suckers. High potassium feeder. Requires windbreaks and drip irrigation for optimal bunch weight.
Pest & Disease Advisory: Panama wilt (Fusarium), Sigatoka leaf spot, rhizome weevil. Dip suckers in Carbendazim and maintain good field drainage.

Suitable Indian States: Uttar Pradesh, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Bihar, Gujarat, Maharashtra, West Bengal, Odisha, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Telangana
Suitable Soil Types: Loamy soil, Alluvial soil, Red soil, Laterite soil
Cultivation Guide: Prefers well-drained deep alluvial or loamy soils. Prune dead wood after harvest. Regulate flowering through paclobutrazol where recommended by SAUs.
Pest & Disease Advisory: Mango hopper, fruit fly, anthracnose. Hang methyl eugenol pheromone traps and spray sulfur/carbendazim during flowering.

Suitable Indian States: Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Odisha, West Bengal, Maharashtra, Assam
Suitable Soil Types: Laterite soil, Sandy soil, Alluvial soil, Red soil
Cultivation Guide: Plant seed palms in pits filled with red earth and compost. Mulch basin with coconut husks. Requires crown cleaning and periodic micronutrient spraying.
Pest & Disease Advisory: Rhinoceros beetle, red palm weevil, root wilt. Place naphthalene balls in top leaf axils; inject bio-agents.

Suitable Indian States: Assam, West Bengal, Himachal Pradesh, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka
Suitable Soil Types: Laterite soil, Red soil, Loamy soil
Cultivation Guide: Cultivated on acidic hill slopes (pH 4.5-5.5) under partial shade. Regular plucking of 'two leaves and a bud' ensures premium commercial quality.
Pest & Disease Advisory: Tea mosquito bug, red spider mite, blister blight. Maintain shade balance and spray wettable sulfur or hexaconazole.

Suitable Indian States: Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Odisha, Assam
Suitable Soil Types: Laterite soil, Red soil, Loamy soil
Cultivation Guide: Requires shade canopy (two-tier shade system), humid mist, and well-distributed rainfall. Arabica prefers higher elevations (1000m+) than Robusta.
Pest & Disease Advisory: Coffee berry borer, white stem borer, leaf rust (Hemileia vastatrix). Trace and burn infested plants; spray Bordeaux mixture.

Suitable Indian States: West Bengal, Bihar, Assam, Odisha, Uttar Pradesh
Suitable Soil Types: Alluvial soil, Clay soil, Loamy soil
Cultivation Guide: Grown in fertile Indo-Gangetic alluvial plains. Retting in clean slow-moving water for 15-20 days is crucial for extracting golden lustrous fiber.
Pest & Disease Advisory: Stem rot, yellow mite, semilooper. Ensure timely thinning, clean water retting, and avoid water stagnation in young crop.
